marketing_wrapper: 01 is entirely marketing (3D card render on grey stone, award badges, no UI). 02-06: black #000000 backdrop, large white caption across the top ~25%, then a cropped UI panel inside a thin grey outline (no device bezel) taking ~55-60% of the frame, and a disclaimer footer band. About 55% real UI on 02-06, 0% on 01.

typography.display: Marketing captions: wide geometric grotesk, medium-bold, tight leading (consistent with Revolut's Aeonik Pro, unsure). In-app titles (Security, Jason) are the same neutral grotesk at semibold.
typography.numerals: proportional-looking bold lining figures for balances; tabular unsure
typography.weights: Balance bold; row titles regular; secondary text regular in grey; buttons medium
typography.case_and_tracking: Sentence case everywhere; normal tracking; no all-caps labels

palette.accent_strategy: No fixed brand accent in UI. Colour comes from per-account wallpaper (photo or gradient header) and per-category circular icons; green is semantic only (status, percent up).
palette.source: palette.json 03 (#000000 53%, #161618 20%), 04 (#212324, #3b3938 grouped card over photo), 05 (#72aebb teal account header gradient); others visual match

shape.radius_language: large: grouped cards ~20pt, UI panel ~24pt; pill 'Accounts' and Send/Request buttons; circular action buttons ~44pt
shape.borders_shadows: No borders or shadows on cards; separation by tonal steps on black
shape.materials: Translucent grey capsules and circles over the wallpaper (blur); otherwise flat

liquid_glass_visible: unclear: the 'Accounts' pill and the four round action buttons are translucent over the photo header and could be iOS 26 glass or a plain blur; no tab bar visible to check
density: medium; generous header (balance block takes ~40% of screen), then 3-row grouped lists with ~60pt rows and 16-20pt gaps between cards
layout: Account screen: full-bleed photo/gradient wallpaper header with centred label + balance + 'Accounts' pill, a row of four circular quick actions (Add money, Move, Info/Details, More), then grouped cards (recent transactions with 'See all', then two half-width stat cards). Security screen: particle-wave header, three round actions, grouped settings list.
navigation: No tab bar visible (cropped). Back arrow in a dark circle on the P2P chat screen; avatar top right. Custom chrome throughout.
imagery_and_icons: Lifestyle photography as account wallpaper (interior, couple); generative particle wave on Security; custom filled glyph icon set in white; flags and merchant logos in circles
signature_visual_move: Each account's balance sits centred on its own full-bleed photo or gradient wallpaper, so the account is identified by an image rather than a colour or name.
tells_present: Gestalt sameness: centred balance over a row of round labelled action buttons, the shared neobank template

direction_fit.secondary: User-Authored Poster (per-account wallpaper as the user's artifact)
direction_fit.why: Text record said modular plus user wallpapers; screenshots confirm wallpaper-led per-account headers and a 'no noise' list core. The dark photographic mood is closer to Cinematic Dark Data than to 'calm', but the canvas is pure #000 not tinted, and no chart is shown, so the fit is loose.

notes: MONEY ANATOMY. Balance: centred white bold, ~2.5-3x body (balance ~44pt vs ~16pt rows) with a small regular label above ('House deposit', 'Joint · GBP', 'Capital at risk'). Whole-pound balances on 02/04 show no pence; 05 shows '£2,840.05' with '.05' at ~40% size, same weight, baseline-aligned (not superscript). £ is full size and weight, no space. Tabular: unsure. Row amounts right-aligned, regular weight, uncoloured: credits '+£0.56', '+£150' in white/grey with a plus sign; debits '-£98.99', '-£1671.20' white with a hyphen-minus (note: no thousands separator on -£1671.20). Green is used only for '▲ 2.52%' and 'Active'. Chart: none shown. Send: P2P is a chat thread where payments are message bubbles (Sent chip, amount ~2x body bold, memo, time), with Request (dark pill) and Send (white pill) above the composer. No amount-entry or confirm screen shown. Disagreement: text record said visuals unknown; the screens show dark mode with black canvas, not the 'calm light modular' the old tag implied.
